adjudication.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/embed.js, the message handler validates the sender with `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`. This accepts any `e.origin` that is a substring/prefix of `discourseUrl` (e.g., `https://forum.example.co` will match `https://forum.example.com/...` at index 0), so an attacker-controlled origin that is a prefix could bypass the check and send `discourse-resize` messages.
